title: AMLC witness: Romualdez's bank transactions hit P4.5 billion during speakership

blocks.text: A financial investigator of the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) told the Sandiganbayan that bank transactions linked to suspended Leyte First District Rep. Martin Romualdez reached about P4.509 billion when he was House speaker from June 2022 to September 2025.
